description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
